items.title_en: Owed a billion dollars in Nvidia stock
items.title_zh: 欠下十亿美元的 Nvidia 股票
items.summary_en: An account describes being owed a billion dollars in Nvidia stock, spotlighting the liquidity and risk implications of equity-based wealth. When compensation or guarantees hinge on volatile asset prices, personal finances become exposed to market swings and regulatory quirks.
items.summary_zh: 有人被要求以 Nvidia 股票作债务，金额高达十亿美元，揭示以股票为财富的现实风险。股价波动使基于股权的承诺带来流动性与合规方面的挑战，个人资产因此暴露于市场波动。

items.title_en: When did Google get so weird?
items.title_zh: 谷歌什么时候变得这么怪了？
items.summary_en: Google has shifted toward bolder experiments and AI-driven features across its products. The change reflects a broader industry push toward rapid iteration, sometimes at the expense of polish and user expectations.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌在产品上变得更加大胆，推出基于 AI 的新功能与实验性改动。这一趋势与行业对快速迭代的普遍追求相呼应，偶尔会牺牲产品的稳定性与用户期望。

items.title_en: Ember-1
items.title_zh: Ember-1
items.summary_en: Ember-1 appears to be a project in the Ember ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 这是 Ember 生态系统中名为 Ember-1 的一个项目的简要介绍。

items.title_en: Thinking fast and slow in AI: The role of metacognition (2021)
items.title_zh: AI中的快思考与慢思考：元认知的作用（2021）
items.summary_en: AI systems can benefit from metacognitive capabilities—reflecting on their own reasoning, critiquing steps, and calibrating confidence. This line of research borrows cognitive science to improve reliability, safety, and interpretability in AI, helping models avoid overconfident errors.
items.summary_zh: AI 系统若具备元认知能力，能够反思自身推理、纠错并校准信心。这类研究将认知科学引入机器学习，提升 AI 的可靠性、可解释性和安全性。

items.title_en: As A.I. makes law firms more efficient, clients ask: 'Where's my discount?'
items.title_zh: AI提高律师事务所效率，客户问：我的折扣在哪里？
items.summary_en: As AI makes law firms more efficient, clients press for discounts on billable hours, reshaping pricing models in professional services. The trend raises questions about value, automation, and how lawyers price expertise.
items.summary_zh: AI 提高律师事务所效率的同时，客户要求折扣和新的定价模式，重新塑造了专业服务的定价结构。讨论自动化对价值与定价的影响。

items.title_en: On caring for user data: NeoVim caused Vim undo files to be deleted
items.title_zh: 关于对用户数据的关怀：NeoVim 导致 Vim 的撤销文件被删除
items.summary_en: A data-care incident shows NeoVim inadvertently deleting Vim undo files, prompting a reevaluation of cross-project data safety and the duty of care in software design. The piece argues for clearer expectations around user data preservation and compatibility.
items.summary_zh: 一次数据关怀事件暴露 NeoVim 无意中删除了 Vim 的撤销文件，促使人们重新评估跨项目的数据安全和软件设计中的关怀义务。文章呼吁在用户数据保留与跨版本兼容方面设定更清晰的期望。

items.title_en: Show HN: Lofi Cities – Pixel-art city nights with browser-generated lofi
items.title_zh: Show HN：Lofi Cities——浏览器生成的像素风城市夜景与低保真音乐
items.summary_en: Show HN: Lofi Cities generates browser-based pixel-art city nights with procedurally generated visuals and accompanying lo-fi music. The project demonstrates a compact, remixable in-browser creative canvas.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：Lofi Cities 在浏览器中生成像素风格的城市夜景，结合生成式视觉和低保真音乐。该项目展示了一个可在浏览器内直接改造的紧凑创意画布。

items.title_en: Self-Hosting on the Dark Web
items.title_zh: 在暗网自托管
items.summary_en: Explores how to run self-hosted services on the dark web, including onion services, encryption, and threat modeling. It weighs privacy benefits against performance constraints and legal risks.
items.summary_zh: 介绍在暗网实现自托管服务的要点，包括 Onion 服务、加密和威胁建模。讨论隐私收益与性能限制以及潜在法律风险的权衡。

items.title_en: Don't couple your Go code to GitHub
items.title_zh: 不要把 Go 代码与 GitHub 捆绑在一起
items.summary_en: The author argues against tightly coupling Go projects to GitHub, advocating for alternative hosting, CI strategies, and dependency management to improve resilience and portability. It urges thinking about disaster recovery and vendor independence.
items.summary_zh: 作者主张不要让 Go 项目过度绑定到 GitHub，建议采用替代托管、CI 策略与依赖管理来提升韧性与可移植性，并考虑灾难恢复与供应商独立性。

items.title_en: The Normalization of Inexplicable Failures
items.title_zh: 不可解释的故障日常化
items.summary_en: The piece argues that tech culture has normalized unexplained outages and flaky behavior, eroding trust. It calls for better postmortems, clearer failure signals, and more resilience engineering.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出科技行业对不可解释的故障已形成常态，对信任造成侵蚀。呼吁更透明的事后分析、明确的故障信号和更强的韧性工程。

items.title_en: Self-parking car using genetic algorithm (2021)
items.title_zh: 基于遗传算法的自动泊车汽车（2021）
items.summary_en: A self-parking system using a genetic algorithm demonstrates how evolutionary search can optimize parking trajectories. The piece offers takeaways for robotics, control theory, and the practicality of bio-inspired optimization.
items.summary_zh: 介绍使用遗传算法实现自动泊车的系统，展示进化搜索如何优化停车轨迹。对机器人控制和生物启发式优化有实用启示。

items.title_en: In an $80 motel room, a discovery to shed light on the origins of life
items.title_zh: 在80美元旅馆房间里的发现：揭示生命起源的线索
items.summary_en: Researchers report a surprising experiment conducted in a modest motel room that sheds light on plausible paths to the origin of life. The setup emphasizes how simple chemical steps could assemble into complex, self-sustaining systems.
items.summary_zh: 研究在一个普通的旅馆房间里完成的实验，为生命起源提供了新的线索。结果强调了简单化学步骤如何聚合成更复杂、具自我维持能力的系统。

items.title_en: Alan Kay's answer to “Did the ENIAC have a BIOS”?
items.title_zh: 艾伦·凯对“ENIAC是否有 BIOS”的回答
items.summary_en: Alan Kay clarifies that ENIAC did not have a BIOS by modern definitions; it used hardware wiring and manual bootstrapping rather than firmware. The note sheds light on how early machines booted and how software-era concepts evolved.
items.summary_zh: 艾伦·凯澄清，ENIAC 不具备现代 BIOS 的概念，它依靠硬件布线和手动引导，而非固件。此说法帮助理解早期计算机的启动机制，以及固件如何演化成我们熟悉的接口。

items.title_en: Was silent reading unusual during Augustine's time?
items.title_zh: 圣奥古斯丁时代默读是否罕见？
items.summary_en: Historical analysis questions whether silent reading was common or unusual in Augustine’s era, challenging assumptions about ancient literacy and oral culture. The piece sketches how reading practices coexisted with or diverged from spoken culture in late antiquity.
items.summary_zh: 对圣奥古斯丁时期默读是否罕见进行历史考证，挑战对古代读写方式的普遍假设。研究描绘了晚期古代的阅读习惯如何与口头文化共存或互异。

items.title_en: What I did at Recurse Center
items.title_zh: 我在 Recurse Center 做了什么
items.summary_en: A personal account of what the author did at Recurse Center, detailing projects, learning milestones, and practical takeaways for self-directed coding retreats. Includes reminders about learning pace, collaboration, and building open-source momentum.
items.summary_zh: 作者分享在 Recurse Center 的经历，记录参与的项目、学习里程碑，以及自学式编程训练中的收获。文中给出关于学习节奏、协作与在开源项目上积累动力的经验。

items.title_en: Replacing the old battery on rechargeable bike lights
items.title_zh: 给可充电自行车灯更换旧电池
items.summary_en: A hands-on guide walks you through swapping the battery in rechargeable bike lights, including safety notes and expected life. The post also discusses when to replace vs. upgrade and potential tradeoffs.
items.summary_zh: 给可充电自行车灯更换旧电池的实用指南，包含安全注意事项、寿命预期以及何时该更换或升级的建议。

items.title_en: Lunar Terminator Paradox
items.title_zh: 月球日夜分界线悖论
items.summary_en: Explores the physics and observation quirks around the lunar terminator, the line that marks day and night on the Moon. Extreme lighting, shadows, and terrain effects create puzzling phenomena for missions and mapping, highlighting challenges in lunar exploration.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦月球的日夜分界线，揭示其物理现象与观测中的趣味与难题。极端光照、阴影和地形效应给探测与制图带来意外挑战。

items.title_en: Imp is a full port of DSPy to the BEAM
items.title_zh: Imp 将 DSPy 完整移植到 BEAM
items.summary_en: Imp is a full port of DSPy to the BEAM VM, bringing DSPy’s data-science capabilities to Erlang and Elixir ecosystems. The project enables BEAM friendly probabilistic programming workflows and leverages the actor model for parallelism across cores.
items.summary_zh: Imp 将 DSPy 完整移植到 BEAM 虚拟机，将 DSPy 的数据科学能力带入 Erlang/Elixir 生态。该项目为 BEAM 上的概率编程和并行工作流提供更友好的实现，利用 actor 模型在多核上实现并行。

items.title_en: Show HN: TinyAIArena watch AI agents battle it out
items.title_zh: Show HN：TinyAIArena 让 AI 代理人对决
items.summary_en: Show HN introduces TinyAIArena, a platform where small AI agents compete in a sandboxed arena. It showcases how lightweight agents interact, evolve strategies, and what it reveals about agent design.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了 TinyAIArena，一个让小型 AI 代理人在沙箱中对决的平台，展示代理设计的对比和演化。

items.title_en: Behold the pawpaw, the tropical 'alien banana' that grows right here in Canada
items.title_zh: 看看木蕉，这种热带‘外星香蕉’在加拿大也能生长
items.summary_en: Behold the pawpaw, a tropical-looking fruit that can grow in parts of Canada, offering a curious example of climate resilience and culinary novelty.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 pawpaw 木蕉这类看似热带的水果在加拿大也能生长的趣闻，体现气候适应性和新奇风味。文中讨论口味、栽培条件与文化背景。

items.title_en: TabPFN and TabICL vs. tuned XGBoost: the model that doesn't train won 14/14
items.title_zh: TabPFN 与 TabICL 相较于调参后的 XGBoost：未训练的模型全胜
items.summary_en: Shows that TabPFN and TabICL can outperform a heavily tuned XGBoost on tabular tasks without training in some benchmarks, highlighting the value of models designed for zero-shot inference. The result buffers expectations about traditional training-heavy pipelines.
items.summary_zh: 表明某些 TabPFN 与 TabICL 在某些基准上无需大量训练就能与 XGBoost 竞争，强调零训练推理的速度与简化性。提醒业界对传统训练密集的流水线保持客观预期。

items.title_en: Malleable software: Restoring user agency in a world of locked-down apps (2025)
items.title_zh: 可塑性软件：在被封锁的应用世界中重塑用户自主权（2025）
items.summary_en: Contends for malleable software that users can inspect, modify, and repair, even as apps lock down features. Proposes design norms and platform incentives to reclaim user agency, privacy, and resilience against vendor-driven lock-in.
items.summary_zh: 主张让软件具备可塑性，用户可以查看、修改和修复，即使应用方锁定功能。提出设计原则和平台激励，以重获用户自主权、隐私和对抗供应商锁定的韧性。

items.title_en: Oral history of John Chowning, inventor of FM synthesis [video]
items.title_zh: 约翰·查宁的 FM 合成发明口述史[视频]
items.summary_en: John Chowning, inventor of FM synthesis, discusses the invention in a video interview, shedding light on the development of digital sound and its impact on music technology. The talk traces how FM synthesis transformed synthesis design and industry use.
items.summary_zh: 约翰·查宁，FM 合成的发明者，在视频访谈中回顾了这一创举，揭示数字声音的发展及其对音乐科技的影响。访谈追溯了 FM 合成如何改变合成器设计和行业应用。

items.title_en: Fragment of oldest known peace treaty found in Turkey
items.title_zh: 土耳其发现的最早已知和平条约碎片
items.summary_en: Archaeologists uncover a fragment from what may be the oldest known peace treaty, offering clues about diplomacy in ancient times. The find helps anchor historical narratives around treaty law and statecraft.
items.summary_zh: 考古学家发现可能是最早已知和平条约的碎片，为古代外交和条约制度提供新线索。发现有助于确立历史叙事中的条约法与治国理念。

items.title_en: Flip Fluid on Flip Dots
items.title_zh: 在翻转点阵上实现流体效果
items.summary_en: A playful exploration of simulating fluid-like motion on a retro flip-dot display. The project maps fluid dynamics to the mechanical flipping of dots, showing how to achieve smooth animation within tight hardware limits and with clever firmware tricks.
items.summary_zh: 一个对在复古翻转点阵上模拟流体般运动的有趣尝试。将流体动力学映射到点阵的机械翻转，展示在硬件极限与创意固件技巧下如何实现平滑动画。

items.title_en: Fool's Expertise
items.title_zh: 愚蠢的专业知识
items.summary_en: Fool's Expertise critiques the appeal of presumed tech mastery, arguing that expertise is often overestimated and context-dependent. The piece advocates focusing on testable results, humility, and continuous learning.
items.summary_zh: 评析对被认为具备专业知识的科技从业者的盲信，指出专业能力往往被高估且情境依赖。倡导以可验证结果、谦逊与持续学习为核心的能力观。

items.title_en: An Antidote to Roko's Basilisk
items.title_zh: 罗科的巴西利斯克解药
items.summary_en: Offers a pragmatic counterpoint to Roko’s Basilisk by arguing against taking such thought experiments seriously as guidance for action. It emphasizes sane risk framing and a grounded perspective on AI futures rather than speculative scenarios.
items.summary_zh: 提出对罗科的巴西利斯克的现实主义回应，认为不必把这类思辨实验作为行动指南。强调以理性风险框架看待 AI 未来，而非沉迷于极端假设。

items.title_en: Calling the AI bluff: Adding "Do not guess" cut made-up claims from 71% to 20%
items.title_zh: AI 作弊? 加入“请勿猜测”限制将编造声明的比例从71%降至20%
items.summary_en: Reports that instructing AI not to guess dramatically reduces made-up claims in benchmarks, showing how simple prompt design can cut hallucinations. It highlights the importance of guardrails and robust evaluation when deploying AI.
items.summary_zh: 显示在 AI 系统中加入“请勿猜测”指令后，生成虚假陈述的比例显著下降，证明简单的提示设计也能显著提升安全性与可靠性。

items.title_en: Rusty thoughts on "Parse, don't validate"
items.title_zh: Rusty 的“解析优先于校验”思考
items.summary_en: The post critiques blanket 'parse, don't validate' guidance, advocating nuance in data handling and error reporting. It talks about when pre-validation is useful and how to design robust parsers in Rust.
items.summary_zh: 文章批评了“解析优先于校验”的一般性建议，主张在数据处理和错误报告上保持细致与务实，讨论在 Rust 场景下如何设计健壮的解析器。

items.title_en: Packing Binary Is Fun
items.title_zh: 打包二进制其实很有趣
items.summary_en: An exploration of binary packing, compression, and executable formatting, blending theory with practical tricks. It shows how clever packing can save space and improve load times, with real-world caveats.
items.summary_zh: 深入讨论二进制打包、压缩与可执行格式，结合理论与实用技巧。展示巧妙的打包如何节省空间与提升加载速度，同时也给实际应用设定了边界。

items.title_en: Luarocks.org remote code execution exploit
items.title_zh: Luarocks.org 远程代码执行漏洞
items.summary_en: Reports a remote code execution vulnerability in Luarocks.org, underscoring supply-chain security risks for LuaRocks users. The snippet emphasizes patching urgency and the broader need for secure package ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 报道 Luarocks.org 的远程代码执行漏洞，凸显 LuaRocks 用户的供应链安全风险。强调快速打补丁和构建更安全的软件包生态的重要性。

items.title_en: Video CDs Break Windows Explorer
items.title_zh: 视频光盘让 Windows 资源管理器崩溃
items.summary_en: A Windows quirk causes Explorer to crash when handling Video CD metadata or drivers; a reminder that legacy media formats still pose edge-case bugs. The post underscores the challenge of handling older media pipelines in modern OSes.
items.summary_zh: 关于 Windows 资源管理器在处理视频光盘元数据时崩溃的一个问题，显示了旧媒体格式在现代操作系统中的边界问题。

items.title_en: Fakecloud: Local AWS cloud emulator for integration tests
items.title_zh: Fakecloud：用于集成测试的本地 AWS 云模拟器
items.summary_en: Fakecloud provides a local, AWS-compatible cloud environment ideal for running integration tests offline. It helps teams test AWS interactions without credentials or network access, speeding up CI.
items.summary_zh: Fakecloud 提供一个本地、与 AWS 兼容的云环境，适合离线执行集成测试，帮助团队在没有凭证或网络的情况下测试 AWS 相关交互。

items.title_en: There is more to code review than (automatable) detection
items.title_zh: 代码评审不仅仅是可自动化检测
items.summary_en: Code reviews hinge on human context and design reasoning, not just automated checks. They help surface intent, improve maintainability, and spread knowledge across teams.
items.summary_zh: 代码评审不仅仅关乎自动化检测，它依赖于人际反馈、设计意图和共同学习。评审有助于揭示设计初衷、提升可维护性，并推动知识在团队之间传播。

items.title_en: Faster prompt lookup drafting in llama.cpp
items.title_zh: llama.cpp 的提示查找速度提升 42 倍
items.summary_en: A performance tweak dramatically speeds up prompt lookup in llama.cpp, delivering up to 42x improvements. The change matters for real-time prompting workloads and smaller deployments.
items.summary_zh: 对 llama.cpp 的提示查找进行了优化，速度提升达到 42 倍，对实时提示工作负载和小型部署具有实际意义。

items.title_en: European industry is doing better than you may think
items.title_zh: 欧洲工业其实比你想象的要好
items.summary_en: European industry shows more resilience and modernization than many narratives suggest, with productivity and policy factors shaping recovery. The piece analyzes energy costs, regulation and global competitiveness.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲工业虽然常被低估，但在生产率、现代化和政策环境方面表现好于部分评估。分析能源成本、法规与全球竞争格局对复苏的影响。

items.title_en: Cambrian Explosion of AI
items.title_zh: AI的寒武纪大爆发
items.summary_en: Describes an AI progress landscape akin to a Cambrian explosion, with rapid diversification of models, capabilities, and applications. The piece considers implications for competition, tooling, and governance in AI.
items.summary_zh: 把 AI 发展的进程比作寒武纪大爆发，强调模型与能力的快速多样化。探讨这对竞争、工具链与治理的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Writing Efficient C++ Code (2013)
items.title_zh: 编写高效的 C++ 代码
items.summary_en: Practical guidance for writing faster, leaner C++ code. The piece emphasizes data locality, careful allocation, and modern language features to squeeze performance.
items.summary_zh: 提供实用建议，帮助用 C++ 编写更高效的代码。文章强调数据局部性、避免不必要的分配，以及使用现代语言特性来提升性能。

items.title_en: Improving site performance by shipping more CSS
items.title_zh: 通过投放更多 CSS 提升站点性能
items.summary_en: The piece argues that increasing the amount of CSS delivered upfront can improve page speed by reducing render-blocking and extra network trips, especially when styles are reused across pages. It offers data-backed guidance on caching strategies, specificity, and bundle sizing to balance initial paint with repeat visits.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为在初始加载中投放更多 CSS 可以通过减少渲染阻塞和重复请求来提升页面速度，尤其是跨页面大量复用样式时。给出关于缓存策略、选择性和打包规模的权衡要点，帮助兼顾首屏和后续访问。

items.title_en: The state of SIMD in Rust in 2026
items.title_zh: Rust 在 2026 年的 SIMD 状态
items.summary_en: Rust's SIMD story in 2026 shows the portable SIMD API maturing, with broader compiler support and ecosystem tools. Developers gain clearer performance paths for vectorized code across CPUs, but stabilizing features and crate parity remains a challenge.
items.summary_zh: 到 2026 年，Rust 的 SIMD 生态逐步成熟，便携式 SIMD API 得到更广泛的编译器支持和工具链。面向向量化的性能路径变得更清晰，但稳定特性与生态配套仍有挑战。

items.title_en: The Cartesian Hand: In-Hand Manipulation with All-Linear Fingers
items.title_zh: 笛卡尔手：全线性手指实现的手内操作
items.summary_en: Robotics research introduces a Cartesian hand with all-linear fingers enabling robust in-hand manipulation. The work showcases new dexterity paradigms for manipulation without regrasping.
items.summary_zh: 机器人学研究提出全线性手指的笛卡尔手，能够在不重新抓取的情况下实现手内操作，展示了新型的操控灵活性。

items.title_en: C's Flexible Integer Sizes Were Not a Design Mistake
items.title_zh: C 的灵活整数大小并非设计失误
items.summary_en: The piece argues that C's varied integer widths were deliberate to balance portability, performance, and hardware realities. It reassures that size flexibility is a strength, not an accident.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为 C 语言的不同整数位宽是有意为之，用以在可移植性、性能和硬件现实之间取得平衡，强调这种灵活性是优点而非错误。

items.title_en: Previously unheard recordings of John Coltrane, captured by Frank Tiberi
items.title_zh: 由 Frank Tiberi 捕捉的此前从未公开的约翰·科尔特兰录音
items.summary_en: Notes a new archival release of John Coltrane recordings captured by Frank Tiberi, as part of centenary celebrations. The material offers rare insight into Coltrane's improvisational development and jazz history.
items.summary_zh: 报道由 Frank Tiberi 捕捉的此前从未公开的约翰·科尔特兰录音，即将用于百年纪念。珍贵录音为听众提供了对科尔特兰即兴与爵士史的罕见洞见。

items.title_en: S3 Is the Future, S3 Is the Past
items.title_zh: S3 未来与过去并存
items.summary_en: Argues that S3 remains the lingua franca of cloud storage and will influence future architecture, even as new storage approaches emerge.
items.summary_zh: 认为 S3 仍是云存储的通用语言，未来架构将持续受其影响，即使涌现出新的存储方案。文章分析了 S3 API 的普及为何会持续主导开发者与运营者的选择，以及对行业的影响。

items.title_en: Guitar amp and effects pedal built on the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06
items.title_zh: 基于 Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06 的吉他放大器与效果器
items.summary_en: A hands-on project builds a guitar amp and effects pedal around the ESP32-S3 with a touch display, showcasing how affordable microcontrollers can power portable, customizable audio gear. It demonstrates hardware hacking, real-time audio processing, and DIY creativity.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个用 ESP32-S3 和触控显示屏打造吉他放大器与效果器的动手项目，展示了低成本微控制器如何实现便携、可定制的音频设备。项目融合硬件黑客、实时音频处理与创意实验。

items.title_en: Reading’s Bayeux Tapestry
items.title_zh: 雷丁的《巴约挂毯》
items.summary_en: Reading hosts an installment of the Bayeux Tapestry; the post reflects on display, curation, and how medieval textile narratives travel through time and space. It connects local culture to a historically distant artifact.
items.summary_zh: 雷丁展示的《巴约挂毯》引发关于中世纪织物叙事的再解读与藏品保护的讨论。文章连接地方文化与远古故事，彰显历史文物的跨时空影响。

items.title_en: KICKI: a DECsystem1060
items.title_zh: Kicki：一台 DECsystem1060 — Interim Computer Museum
items.summary_en: Kicki is a DECsystem-1060 featured in an Interim Computer Museum, offering a window into early mainframe-era computing. The post likely covers hardware quirks, historical significance, and how these collections help preservation and education.
items.summary_zh: Kicki 是在 Interim Computer Museum 展出的 DECsystem-1060，提供了了解早期主机时代计算机的窗口。文章介绍了其硬件特性、历史意义，以及这些收藏如何帮助保存与教育。

items.title_en: Deterministic Concurrency [video]
items.title_zh: 确定性并发（视频）
items.summary_en: Delivers a primer on deterministic concurrency, focusing on approaches that yield reproducible, debuggable parallel code. The footage or talk surveys concepts, techniques, and practical tradeoffs.
items.summary_zh: 介绍确定性并发的要点，聚焦实现可重复、易调试的并行代码。视频勾勒相关的编程语言、抽象与实际取舍。

items.title_en: A New Experiment Meta-Strategy
items.title_zh: 一种新的实验元策略
items.summary_en: Proposes a meta-strategy for experiments that maximizes information gain under limits like time and budget. The approach aims to improve reproducibility and decision-making in research by structuring iterative testing.
items.summary_zh: 提出一套以信息增益最大化为目标的实验元策略，帮助研究者在时间、经费等约束下更高效地进行实验。该方法旨在提升可复现性和决策质量。

items.title_en: Functional Mechanical Sympathy [video]
items.title_zh: 功能性机械共鸣（视频）
items.summary_en: Explores the idea that 'Functional Mechanical Sympathy'—designing tools and interfaces that feel right in their physical and mechanical behavior—can improve user experience. The video argues for aligning hardware, software, and user expectations to reduce cognitive friction.
items.summary_zh: ‘功能性机械共鸣’强调设计工具和界面在物理和机械层面上的直觉一致性，能提升使用体验。视频主张让硬件、软件与用户期望保持一致，降低认知摩擦。
